notes.title: Belongings 1.11 - Small Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Updated the developer's logo in the splash screen.
[*] Updated the credits.
[/list]


People may ask me, "So, any actual improvements in this update?" Yes, no real improvements. Sorry. The file management I did 4 years ago is pretty messy; it took time to even figure out where the menu handler is. It was like decrypting, despite the fact that there’s no real programming code. In short, I hesitate to improve Belongings.

But Belongings is the reason why I’m living as a game developer today. I hope I can do something meaningful for this game in the future.

notes.title: RE is reborn as 4-Cube Games
notes.notes:
Hi.

I started living as an independent game developer in December 2019 as Rectangle Eyes. At that time, I was somewhere between an amateur and a professional; I didn’t really know what I should do as a professional.

The name says it all. By mathematical definition, a square is a type of rectangle, but you see, nobody calls a square a rectangle in everyday life. I’m not sure how many people care about mathematical terms, but I care, at least.

RE would turn 4 years old this coming December, so I think this is a good time to change the name and move to the next, higher dimensions.

The name has changed, but my focus remains on creating 90s-style video games. I’m still the same mysterious developer, Laskow, so you can call me Laskow as usual. Just remember, Laskow’s new studio name is now about 4-dimensional stuff!


Thanks,
Laskow
4-Cube Games

notes.title: Borrowhelen, my 2nd game, will be released on September 25
notes.notes:

I'm very excited to finally be able to share about the Project Andromeda.

Since 4 years after releasing Belongings, Rectangle Eyes will release the second game, [b]Borrowhelen[/b], on September 25, 2024.
